rules: Only CURRENT derived_features with a numeric value_num are eligible.
Each feature_name/source/unit/timezone forms its own series; sources are never merged.
Sleep: only existing sleep_source_episode.* derived features are eligible; no canonical night is invented.
Steps/calories: baselined source-scoped with VENDOR_BUCKET_WIDTH_UNRESOLVED preserved; not reinterpreted as total daily energy expenditure.
Missing is never zero, never forward/backward filled, never interpolated.
